de.abas.erp.common.type.enums

Enum EnumOperatingLanguage

  • Object
    • Enum<EnumOperatingLanguage>
      • EnumOperatingLanguage
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AbasEnum, AbasType, Serializable, Cloneable, Comparable<EnumOperatingLanguage>

    public enum EnumOperatingLanguage
extends Enum<EnumOperatingLanguage>
implements AbasEnum
    This java enum represents the standard abas erp enumeration Operating language (A160).
    It is independent from a specific ERP client.
